scope_notes: ExtrudeSrfAlongCrv uses native boundary chains and exact translational NURBS wall construction via SmPrimitiveCreation::CreateCurveSweepFromEdges with bTranslationalSweep and bMoveToProfile. Only lamina boundary edges are used. The native primitive planar cap builder is disabled: the adapter copies actual source faces and translated copies, retaining curved caps and trim holes.

The source stays at its original position; path position is independent. Original and endpoint-translated cap images are checked across UV orientations and parameter domains. Interior curved-wall samples distinguish the path sweep from a straight displacement. Planar and warped analytic volumes and rational holes pass. Source and path remain unchanged.

Closed or degenerate prepared paths, closed/no-boundary source shapes, invalid source references and unsupported imports decline. Aggregate profile/path control-net budgets account conservatively for composite construction and degree elevation before allocating tensor-product surfaces. A 50000-control-point rail exercises the guard and preserves its source.

Solid, DeleteInput, Reverse, PathLength, Face/Faces/FaceRefs, explicit Path and unique PathName selectors are supported. Reverse is applied before arc-length trimming from the prepared start. Outputs and source remainders stage before one command batch. DeleteInput preserves the path; remaining source faces retain identity, attributes and groups. A later tangent face failure preserves document state, picks, history and Redo.

The application freezes face references and source snapshots, accepts object/face-component preselection or source picking, then filters path picking to curves. Inline source selectors/options survive source selection. Picker options accept document units for PathLength. Invalid options are atomic; kernel failure and changed source geometry retain the picker. Cancellation releases it without geometry edits. Command history/completion and component preselection recognize the active path picker.

Seven independent fixtures run the actual command and measure volumes, face counts, solid flags and native tight geometric bounds. The geometric bound distinguishes a quadratic path locus from its larger control hull. Pending Rhino recipes use public BrepFace.CreateExtrusion, Reverse, LengthParameter and Trim, copying/discarding all owned geometry. Python mock tests check dispatch/ownership, not native parity.

Automatic path direction from the clicked endpoint, native SubCurve point picking, ToBoundary, SplitAtTangents control, live previews, saved option defaults and full native getter behavior remain future work. General self-intersection, folding and near-degenerate surfaces require broader qualification.

No new licensed Rhino capture or launch was attempted because of the documented Wine SSPI startup failure. Retained observations are local debug-profile Viboceros output. Timings include command, document and diagnostic work (including tight-bound reimport) and do not establish comparative kernel performance.
